_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at.

moves.source: Consensus ~$1.61 EPS / ~$11.31B rev. Positioning crowded, targets raised into the print.
moves.resolved: 8/5 open: the 'gaps down hard' branch fired. Bid 491.73 against a 518.58 official close, about -5.2%, versus a 10% implied move - so the realised move was inside what the straddle priced, in the direction the crowded positioning was exposed to. Spot above is the pre-print quote the implied move was pulled against and is left as read. No position was open into it.

branches.cond: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the open
branches.why: Checklist item 2. Enter the day-2 hold, not the overnight coin flip.
Let the flush finish. There is no second balance.
Buy what has not moved. Chasing after the run is the +8% day.

moves.ticker: APP / DASH / IONQ / JOBY / SMR / SOUN
moves.source: Cluster re-verified against the broker earnings calendar at the 8/5 open: all six confirmed reporting after today's close. JOBY was on the candidate list flagged no-fly but missing from this cluster label and has been added. No straddle pulled on any of them - impliedMove stays null because none was read, not as a placeholder to guess at, and nothing is held into tonight to need one.

branches.why: An overnight hold through a print is a decision or an accident. Default is exit.
Checklist item 3. A hold is a coin flip on the implied move. Know the number or skip it.

branches.act: Close, or write the hold down
branches.why: The hold gets pre-decided with the implied move attached, or it does not happen.

branches.cond: Any entry opened on or after 8/5
branches.act: Pull the ATM straddle before sizing
branches.why: A five-session time stop opened today expires on or about 8/12, so the print sits inside the intended hold rather than outside it. Item 3 applies to this name now; treating it as earnings-free was the stale read.

branches.act: Close, or write the hold down with the implied move attached
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and an equity hold through one is a coin flip that gets pre-decided or does not happen.
